SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch Registry.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No D. 5527 Date 9 / 12 / 33）
Date December 9, 1933.
Subject (in full).................................................Rescoe L. Hambleton.
..K. I. Q 8538.
Made by....................and........................Forwarded by...C. D. I. Prince.

Information has been received from a reliable
source to the effect that Rescoe L. Hambleton, an American
citizen, who has during the past few years resided in
Shanghai, is subject to a claim made against him, by one
Lawrence Impey, a British subject, resident of Peking,
for M.$10,000, the computed value of certain curios, etc.
consigned to him for disposal in the U.S.A. In 1931,
R. L. Hambleton was the local representative for the Pioneer
Instrument Company Inc' - Division of Bendix Aviation
Corporation, New York, U.S.A. and had an office, and
manufacturers' agency, at No.3 Canton Road, Shanghai.
In June 1931, R.L. Hambleton went on a visit to the U.S.A.
and L. Impey, who was on friendly terms with him at that
time, entrusted him with the disposal in America of the
property in question, part of which he took with him,
the remainder being sent there to him through other mediums.
R.L. Hambleton returned to Shanghai in February, 1932
and, in communications he sent to L. Impey in Peking, stated
that owing to unfavourable circumstances he had not been
able to dispose of the curios etc., and had left them in
U.S.A. to be disposed of. From time to time during the
period following, up September 30, 1933, L. Impey in
correspondence, and through Messrs Schuhl-Davies and Lurten,
a firm of local lawyers, has brought pressure to bear on
R.L. Hambleton for payment of the claim of $10,000 against
him, or the return of the curios, etc., but without avail.
R.L. Hambleton left Shanghai for America on the s.s.
"President Lincoln" on September 30, 1933 and the matter
of the aforementioned claim is pending his return.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.I，特务科档案室。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科档案室。编号 D. 5527 日期 33年12月9日）
日期：1933年12月9日。
事由（全称）.................................................Rescoe L. Hambleton。
..K. I. Q 8538。
制作人....................及........................转呈人...C. D. I. Prince。

据可靠消息来源称，美国公民 Rescoe L. Hambleton 在过去几年中居住于上海，现有一名居住在北平的英国臣民 Lawrence Impey 向其提出索赔，金额为规元10,000两，系委托其在美国处置的某些古玩等物的估算价值。1931年，R. L. Hambleton 担任美国纽约 Bendix Aviation Corporation 下属 Pioneer Instrument Company Inc' 的本地代表，并在上海广东路3号设有办公室及制造商代理处。1931年6月，R.L. Hambleton 前往美国访问，当时与其交好的 L. Impey 委托其在美国处置上述财产，其中部分由其随身携带，其余部分则通过其他渠道寄往美国交予他。R.L. Hambleton 于1932年2月返回上海，并在致北平 L. Impey 的通信中称，由于情况不利，他未能处置这些古玩等物，已将其留在美国待售。在此后的期间内，直至1933年9月30日，L. Impey 通过信函以及经由本地律师事务所 Schuhl-Davies and Lurten 向 R.L. Hambleton 施压，要求其支付针对他的10,000美元索赔款，或归还古玩等物，但均未果。R.L. Hambleton 于1933年9月30日乘“林肯总统”号轮船离开上海前往美国，上述索赔事宜待其归来后处理。

in sharp practices.
